summary: Advance the research manager to define a bounded question comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets using specific benchmarks.
body: The previous research loop (research-1789619937785) failed to produce empirical evidence comparing dynamic consolidation policies against simple baselines (e.g., append-only Markdown) under identical token constraints. Sources described methods but lacked controlled comparisons. Per protocol, the current bounded cycle is closed with explicit limitations: findings are descriptive, not causal; stopping rule compliance is unverified; no code execution occurred. The authorized research program continues. Assign the research manager to define a new bounded question targeting a specific, reproducible benchmark that explicitly matches token budgets and compares success/hallucination rates. Limit to 4 sources. Do not implement.
